unresolved.first_comment: P1: Remove development pins before publishing reflex-i18n. With the new dispatch-release option, selecting reflex-i18n's dev pins would be unpublishable.
P2: With PathPrefixRouting(default_at_root=False), this adds prefixed pages but leaves the original unprefixed app page available at /. Remove or redirect the base page...
P2: When a base route starts with a configured locale segment, delocalize and locale_of reserve it as a prefix, so /de/pricing is treated as German instead of a base route.
P2: When an app already owns a locale-prefixed route such as /de, this expansion raises RouteValueError instead of preserving the app page.

outstanding_asks.ask: Remove/resolve unpublishable dev pins in packages/reflex-i18n/pyproject.toml before release.
PathPrefixRouting(default_at_root=False) can leave the unprefixed base app page reachable at '/' alongside the prefixed locale pages.
delocalize/locale_of can misclassify an app route that happens to start with a configured locale segment (e.g. /de/pricing).
Route expansion can raise RouteValueError instead of preserving an app-owned locale-prefixed route like /de.
